items.title: The Mormon Truth Test Is Broken: 4 Flaws in the “Burning in the Bosom”
items.summary: A Mormon News Roundup YouTube Short argues that the emotional feeling members are told confirms Mormonism cannot distinguish truth from sincere belief, and outlines four flaws in the "burning in the bosom" test.

items.title: More tickets to tour the renovated Salt Lake Temple will be available Tuesday. See when.
items.summary: The Salt Lake Tribune reports that The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints has announced additional free tour tickets for the renovated Salt Lake Temple will be released Tuesday at 11 a.m. Mountain time. The article says the first 1 million tickets were claimed in less than 24 hours in September and that public tours will run from April 5 through Oct. 1, 2027.
